title: Test-Driven Development (TDD) — A Practical Workflow
description: Runnable companion for the TDD guide: the ShoppingCart built cycle-by-cycle in pytest (five tests, one per red-green-refactor loop) plus a Jest + supertest suite for POST /api/transfers with wiring stubs ready to connect.
description_es: Companion ejecutable de la guía TDD: el ShoppingCart construido ciclo a ciclo en pytest (cinco tests, uno por ciclo red-green-refactor) más una suite Jest + supertest para POST /api/transfers con stubs listos para conectar.
